name: Ligungi
storyline: Gungi is a board game invented for Yoshihiro Togashi's HUNTER×HUNTER manga, a game of military strategy where pieces stack into towers. It becomes central to the Chimera Ant arc through the games between the Chimera Ant King and Komugi, a blind girl who is the game's undefeated champion. In 2022 Universal Music Japan released Gungi as a real board game, with official rules written with the permission of the work's rights holders. ligungi follows those rules.
summary: Ligungi is a free, open source website to play Gungi (軍儀), the two-player strategy board game from the HUNTER×HUNTER manga, with the official rules published in 2022. Pieces can be stacked into towers of up to three, and a tower's height extends the reach of the piece on top. Players build their armies in an open draft, taking turns, or start from fixed setups. It offers rated and casual games with Glicko-2 ratings, correspondence games, play against the computer, daily puzzles, Puzzle Streak and Puzzle Storm, interactive lessons, studies, an analysis board and a screen reader mode. A fan project, not officially affiliated with the rights holders.
